blocks.text: Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) aise organic compounds hain jo chemical, biological aur photolytic (roshni se hone wale) processes se aasani se nahi toot-te. Yeh zehreele hain, insani sehat aur environment ko nuqsan dete hain, aur hawa aur paani ke zariye door door tak safar karte hain. Ek mulk mein bane POPs un logon aur jangli janwaron (wildlife) ko bhi nuqsan de sakte hain jo un ke istemal ki jagah se bohat door hain.
Kyun ke yeh lambe arse tak qaim rehte hain (persistence), environment mein jama hote rehte hain aur insani sehat par bohat bure asraat dal sakte hain. Kuch POPs Table 14.1 mein diye gaye hain:

blocks.caption: Table 14.1 Kuch POPs aur un ke istemal
rows: bijli ke aalaat (electrical equipment), surface coating ink, adhesives (gond) aur paints

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne DDT ka naam 'Dichlorobiphenyl tri-chloroethane' likha hai. Sahi naam dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane hai.

blocks.prompt: Persistent organic pollutants ke environment par kya asraat hain?
blocks.explanation: PCBs aur DDT jaise POPs aasani se nahi toot-te, is liye saalon qaim rehte hain, hawa aur paani se sarhadon ke paar pohnchte hain, aur mitti, paani aur food chain mein janwaron ki charbi mein jama hote rehte hain. Is tarah woh apne source se door ke janwaron aur insanon ko bhi zehar dete hain.

items: POPs aasani se nahi toot-te, zehreele hain, hawa aur paani se door tak jate aur jama hote hain: PCBs (bijli ke aalaat, paints), DDT (insecticide).
